python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,re
from collections import defaultdict
D=pd.read_csv('/work/b3_supercon_data.csv')
bounds=dict(zip('O Cu Ba Sr Y Ca La Bi Fe Nb C Pr As B Pb Ce Mo V Zn Ni'.split(),[.697674,.454545,.333333,.285714,.4,.272727,.78,.521978,.502513,.98,.972,.265043,.5,1,.5,.28,1,.9918,1,.6]))
def parse(s):
 d=defaultdict(float)
 tokens=re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)(\d*\.?\d*)',s)
 assert ''.join(a+b for a,b in tokens)==s,s
 for a,b in tokens:d[a]+=float(b or 1)
 total=sum(d.values())
 return {a:v/total for a,v in d.items()}
D['fractions']=D.composition.map(parse)
D['eligible']=D.fractions.map(lambda d:all(a in bounds and x<=bounds[a]+1e-6 for a,x in d.items()))
print('Samples:',len(D),'eligible:',D.eligible.sum())
print('\nHighest observed Tc rows:')
print(D.nlargest(12,'target')[['composition','target','eligible']].to_string(index=False))
print('\nHighest eligible rows:')
print(D[D.eligible].nlargest(12,'target')[['composition','target']].to_string(index=False))
best=D[D.eligible].nlargest(1,'target').iloc[0]
print('\nBest fractions:',best.fractions,'sum:',sum(best.fractions.values()))
PY
